Demo of a small embedded device using an RP2350 and WIZ5500 ethernet controller.
When connected to the PC network port on snom VOIP phones it will then discover the local phone via LLDP and update its action URLs so that the phone sends webhooks to the device when it rings/missed call etc.

The only device configuration it needs is the phones admin password which can be set via serial console and is then stored encrypted in the device.

This pager was released in 1989, I wonder how long it is since it last received a message!
Still working fine today though, with a Pi Pico, Sx1278 and RadioLib

videos.t: MacOS Remote Desktop from iPad with Resolution switching
videos.desc:
Something I've wanted for a long time was a nice way of using my Dekstop Mac via remote desktop from my iPad Pro with a keyboard and mouse, One of the big problems i had was that i use an ultrawide monitor with my Mac so the desktop runs at 5120x1440, however when connected from the iPad the desktop is then scaled and you have a tiny letterbox view.
Apples  High Speed Screen Sharing from the MacBook takes care of this by runnig the desktop at the MacBooks native resolution when connected but I wanted to use my iPad and despite it being an M1 Apple never extended this feature to iPadOS
